policy.scope: Desktop-only bounded stationary-tone fitting before a separately named detector; preserve raw IQ and raw scores
policy.interpretation: Empirical development controls, not specificity proof. The fit can remove part of a real signal. Compare pure controls, unmodified RF, and RF plus a tone; retain failed and changed results.

detector.development_basis: The full local-refinement differential proposal detects all wider reference-positive probes, with one CFO mismatch. Native local correlation dominates proposal cost. Test ranking centers first and refining only the retained neighborhood.
detector.scope: Staged native differential proposals with unchanged original-IQ fractional confirmation
algorithm_changes: Rank the eight native-rate proposal-center scores, then evaluate the two neighboring native cells only for the retained proposal. This may change candidate ranking and must be separately quality-tested.
